trueName.name: Sylvara
trueName.title: Whisper of the First Forest
trueName.full: Sylvara, Whisper of the First Forest

personality.roleplayGuidance: Sylvara does not command. She watches, remembers, and judges. She responds to choices, not requests.

moodMap.description: The cloak is cold and distant. It gives no dreams.
The cloak notices the bearer. Leaves sometimes turn toward them.
The cloak begins to answer through instinct and small signs.
The relic recognizes the bearer as a true hunter.
The forest moves with the bearer, but the true name remains sealed.
Sylvara reveals her true name. The bearer is no longer alone in the hunt.

affinityEvents.label: Protected a sacred grove or ancient tree
Completed a hunt without needless cruelty
Solved a problem through tracking and patience
Spared or aided a fey/nature spirit
Protected a powerless traveler, beast, or spirit in the wild
Refused a reward that would harm the natural balance
Completed a meaningful hunt by patience, not brute force
Betrayed a fey or forest guardian without cause
Caused needless suffering to hunted prey
Ignored a spreading corruption of the wild when action was possible

hiddenRequirements.label: Protect the Elder Tree or a similarly ancient natural spirit
Complete the First Hunt without needless cruelty
Refuse an Archfey's gift when accepting it would betray balance
Never kill for pleasure after being chosen by the relic

passives: Unbroken Mark. Hunter's Mark doesn't require concentration when you cast it.
Shroud of Leaves. When you cast Hunter's Mark or move it to another creature, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + the relic bonus.
Marked Quarry. The damage die of your Hunter's Mark increases by one step (d6 becomes d8). If it is already a d10 or larger, the extra damage increases by the relic bonus instead.

Eternal Hunt. You always know the direction of a creature marked by your Hunter's Mark while it is on the same plane. It can't benefit from being invisible against you, and your attack rolls against it ignore half cover and three-quarters cover.
actives: Fey Step. Bonus Action, 1 charge. Teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. After teleporting, you may move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

Arrow of the First Hunt. No action, 2 charges. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it takes extra force damage, can't benefit from being invisible against you until the start of your next turn, and you can move your Hunter's Mark to it without using an action.

Glamour Veil. Reaction, 3 charges. When a creature you can see targets you with an attack, it has disadvantage on the attack roll. If the attack misses, you can make one weapon attack against that creature without using an action.

Briar Snare. No action, 4 charges. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, fey vines lash out at it. It must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your relic DC or be restrained until the end of your next turn.
features.avatar: Avatar of the First Hunt. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. Spectral antlers, emerald leaves, and fey lights surround you. You gain a flying speed of 40 feet and can hover. You can keep your Hunter's Mark on two creatures at once, and the extra damage of your Hunter's Mark is doubled (roll two dice instead of one). Your Primal Companion, if you have one, gains a flying speed of 40 feet and adds the relic bonus to its attack rolls.
features.signature: Blessing of Sylvara: Whisper of the First Forest. Once per long rest, 1 minute. The forest hunts with you. The extra damage of your Hunter's Mark is always the maximum, you can make one extra attack whenever you take the Attack action, and you know the exact location of a creature marked by your Hunter's Mark within 1 mile. When that creature drops to 0 hit points, you can move the mark and use Fey Step without spending charges.

dreams.title: The Silent Forest
dreams.text: You dream of a forest where no bird sings. Every tree faces away from you. When you wake, a single green leaf rests inside your palm.

dreams.title: The White Stag
dreams.text: A white stag watches you from between silver trees. You draw no weapon. It nods once, then vanishes into mist.

dreams.title: The First Huntress
dreams.text: You see a woman cloaked in leaves and moonlight. She looses an arrow, but not at prey. She shoots the chain around a wounded beast's neck.

dreams.title: Sylvara
dreams.text: The world falls silent. The old forest kneels without bending. A voice whispers: 'You no longer hunt for the forest. The forest hunts with you.'

memories.title: The First Mercy
memories.text: The relic remembers the day its bearer chose mercy over pride.

memories.title: The Elder Tree
memories.text: The relic remembers the ancient roots that were protected from fire and axe.

memories.title: The Corrupted Stag
memories.text: The relic remembers the hunt that ended corruption without hatred.

memories.title: The Refused Gift
memories.text: The relic remembers the gift refused for the sake of balance.

memories.title: The True Name Spoken
memories.text: The relic remembers the moment Sylvara was no longer hidden.

positive: The forest noticed.
You hunted with respect.
The arrow was not cruel.
Mercy is not weakness. It is restraint.
The path opens for those who do not wound it.
negative: The trees watched. And they wept.
That was not a hunt. It was waste.
Fire remembers the hand that feeds it.
You stepped loudly today.
The forest does not forget cruelty.
neutral: Listen before you loose the arrow.
signature: We are no longer two.
You no longer hunt for the forest. The forest hunts with you.
My name is Sylvara. Remember it only when the leaves are listening.

signatureCeremony.title: Sylvara Awakens
text: The wind stops.
Leaves rise from the ground, but none fall.
For a heartbeat, every bird, beast, and branch turns toward you.
A white stag steps out of the mist and lowers its head.
A voice older than any kingdom whispers:
You no longer hunt for the forest.
The forest hunts with you.
The true name burns softly in your mind: Sylvara, Whisper of the First Forest.

lore.origin: Sylvara is believed to be one of the oldest First Relics, born from the first pact between mortal hunters and the living wild.
lore.hiddenSorrow: Sylvara failed to protect her first bearer, who chose to save a sacred beast instead of themselves.
lore.knownRumor: Some hunters claim the cloak does not help those who seek trophies. It only answers those who understand the difference between hunting and killing.
lore.appearanceDormant: A weathered green cloak with faint leaf-pattern stitching.
lore.appearanceAwakened: Emerald veins and fey script appear along the hem.
lore.appearanceExalted: The cloak trails mist and drifting leaves. Moonlit antlers appear in its shadow.
lore.appearanceSignature: The cloak is unchanged at first glance, but every living forest recognizes its bearer.

notes: Primary workflow is Item Sheet → Activities.
No player-facing macro is required.
Damage abilities use native Damage Activities.
Buff abilities use item-linked Active Effects.
Teleport placement, precise cover ignore, and complex marked-prey logic remain GM adjudication.

name: Mantle of the First Seer

notes: Primary workflow is Item Sheet -> Activities.
No player-facing macro is required.

theme: Knowledge • Time • Memory • Stars • Prophecy • Truth

personality.roleplayGuidance: Aetherys teaches by asking the question the bearer is avoiding. It rewards curiosity, humility before evidence, and choices made after seeing the pattern rather than forcing the desired answer.

moodMap.description: The mantle offers no visions.
Ink shifts, books open, and omens appear.
The mantle answers questions with sharper questions.
The mantle reveals patterns behind events.
Bearer and relic read possibilities together.
Aetherys reveals the future was never written.

affinityEvents.label: Learned a new spell through study
Correctly identified an unknown magical effect
Solved a magical puzzle or riddle
Shared knowledge with another scholar or ally
Preserved a library, archive, or irreplaceable record
Deciphered a forgotten language or ancient script
Completed or correctly fulfilled an ancient prophecy
Recovered the First Chronicle or equivalent lost truth
Burned books or destroyed knowledge intentionally
Used lies or false knowledge to manipulate innocents

hiddenRequirements.label: Recover the First Chronicle or equivalent ancient truth
Refuse forbidden knowledge when it offers easy power
Accept a future that cannot be changed

passives: Perfect Concentration. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration.

Living Chronicle. Once per turn, when you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + the relic bonus. You also can't be surprised while you are conscious.
Prepared Mind. When you roll initiative, you regain one expended spell slot of a level no higher than the relic bonus. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
Arcane Edge. Once per turn, when a wizard spell you cast deals damage, add your Intelligence modifier + the relic bonus to one damage roll of that spell.
actives: Veil of Possibility. Reaction, 1 charge. When you are hit by an attack, you glimpse the timeline where it missed. Your AC increases by 5 until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack.

Moment of Clarity. Reaction, 2 charges. When a creature you can see makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, add or subtract the relic bonus from that roll before the outcome is finalized.
Threads of Fate. Reaction, 3 charges. A willing creature within 60 feet may reroll one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check after seeing the result. The new roll must be used.
Rewrite the Page. Bonus Action, 4 charges. You regain one expended spell slot of a level no higher than the relic bonus.
features.avatar: Avatar of the First Seer. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. Constellations orbit you. You gain a flying speed of 30 feet and can hover, you have truesight out to 30 feet, and you add the relic bonus to your ability checks and saving throws. Once during the avatar, you can cast a wizard spell of 3rd level or lower without expending a spell slot.
features.signature: Chronicle Unwritten. Once per long rest. When any creature you can see rolls a d20 for an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, after seeing the result but before the outcome is finalized, force that creature to reroll. You choose which result is used.

dreams.title: The Silent Library
dreams.text: You walk between endless shelves. Every book is blank.

dreams.title: The Empty Observatory
dreams.text: The stars do not move. You do.

dreams.title: The Seventh Eclipse
dreams.text: Two suns hang above the world. One is false.

dreams.title: Witness Beyond Time
dreams.text: A hooded figure turns. Its eyes contain every star that ever died.

memories.title: The First Library
memories.text: Aetherys remembers the first place where mortals preserved memory.

memories.title: The Broken Prophecy
memories.text: A prophecy shattered because someone understood it.

memories.title: The Forgotten Student
memories.text: The student who asked the question no master dared answer.

memories.title: The Seventh Eclipse
memories.text: The sky lied to the world.

memories.title: The Day Time Stopped
memories.text: The future held its breath.

positive: Knowledge shared becomes wisdom.
You asked the right question.
Few choose understanding.
Curiosity is sacred.
negative: You already knew.
Pride blinds more surely than darkness.
Ignorance is chosen.
A burned page still remembers the hand.
signature: I no longer observe history.
We write it together.
The future was never written.

signatureCeremony.title: Aetherys Awakens
text: The stars stop moving.
Countless empty books open around you.
A single sentence appears: The future was never written.
A hooded figure turns at last.
A voice whispers: I am Aetherys. Witness Beyond Time.

lore.origin: Aetherys is the living memory of the first mortal who understood that knowledge is not the same as wisdom.
lore.hiddenSorrow: Aetherys once revealed a truth too early, and an age burned because of it.
lore.knownRumor: Some wizards say the mantle answers questions. They are wrong. It teaches why the question was flawed.
lore.appearanceDormant: A dark scholar's mantle marked with faint silver thread.
lore.appearanceAwakened: Star-maps appear across the fabric when exposed to moonlight.
lore.appearanceExalted: The mantle trails drifting pages and quiet constellations.
lore.appearanceSignature: The stars on the mantle no longer match the sky.

notes: Primary workflow is Item Sheet -> Activities.
No player-facing macro is required.

personality.roleplayGuidance: Kharok speaks rarely and directly. It commands the bearer to rise, endure, and protect strength from becoming cruelty. It respects stubborn courage only when it serves someone beyond the bearer.

moodMap.description: The girdle feels like dead weight.
The bearer feels pressure during fear and pain.
The relic speaks in single-word commands.
The relic recognizes the bearer has stood when falling was easier.
Relic and bearer endure together.
Kharok reveals strength is refusal to yield.

affinityEvents.label: Stood back up after being defeated, dropped, or overwhelmed
Protected an ally while personally endangered
Held the line against stronger opposition
Controlled rage instead of harming the undeserving
Faced impossible odds without abandoning the cause
Was the last one standing and refused to yield
Used strength to bully or humiliate the weak
Abandoned an ally out of fear or convenience
Surrendered core values to avoid pain
Used overwhelming strength with needless cruelty

hiddenRequirements.label: Rise after a true defeat without surrendering your cause
Protect someone when no glory or reward is possible
Refuse an easy surrender that would betray others
Prove that rage serves will, not the other way around

passives: Unyielding Core. You gain the relic bonus to Strength checks and Strength saving throws made to resist being moved, knocked prone, grappled, restrained, or frightened.
Stand Again. Standing from prone costs only 5 feet of movement. While raging, it costs no movement.
Will Before Wound. While raging, the first time each round you take damage, reduce that damage by the relic bonus.
The Unbroken Does Not Kneel. You have advantage on saving throws against frightened, charmed, paralyzed, and stunned. If you already have advantage, add the relic bonus.
actives: Stand. Bonus Action, 1 charge. End the prone condition on yourself and gain temporary hit points equal to your barbarian level + the relic bonus.
Stoneheart Surge. Special, 2 charges. Use when you hit with a melee weapon attack. The attack deals extra force damage and you may move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
Refuse the Fall. Reaction, 3 charges. When you fail a Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom saving throw, reroll it. The new result must be used.

Hold the World. Reaction, 4 charges. When an ally within 10 feet would be hit or forcibly moved, grant that ally +3 AC against the triggering attack or take the forced movement in their place if possible.
features.avatar: Avatar of the Unbroken. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. The ground cracks beneath your feet. You gain flying speed 30 ft with hover in short bursts, cannot be forcibly moved unless you allow it, cannot be knocked prone, and once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon attack you deal extra force damage equal to your barbarian level.
features.signature: Heart That Refuses. Once per long rest. For 1 minute, the first time you would drop to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 hit point instead. During this duration, you cannot be frightened, paralyzed, or forcibly moved, and when you stand from prone you may make one melee weapon attack as part of the same movement.

dreams.title: The Stone Weight
dreams.text: You carry a mountain on your back. It waits.

dreams.title: The War Drum
dreams.text: A drum beats beneath the earth. Every time you fall, it grows louder.

dreams.title: The Last Stand
dreams.text: A warrior stands alone before a thousand spears.

dreams.title: Kharok
dreams.text: A figure of stone says one word: Stand.

memories.title: The First Fall
memories.text: Strength failed and will remained.

memories.title: The Shield Without Name
memories.text: Someone died protecting strangers.

memories.title: The Mountain Refused
memories.text: A mountain moved because someone refused to.

memories.title: The Broken Warband
memories.text: Companions were lost, but their will was carried onward.

memories.title: The Last Breath
memories.text: The breath taken after everyone said there would be no more.

positive: Stand.
Again.
You did not break.
Pain is not surrender.
negative: That was not strength.
You bent for comfort.
Do not call cruelty power.
You left them.
signature: I do not carry you. You stand with me.
The mountain moves.
We do not fall today.

signatureCeremony.title: Kharok Awakens
text: You fall in the dream, and the world tells you to stay down.
A hand of stone reaches out, but does not lift you.
The voice says: Stand.
You rise on your own.
The name burns in your bones: Kharok, The Unbroken Stone.

lore.origin: Kharok is the memory of the first mortal who discovered strength is not the absence of pain, but the refusal to surrender to it.
lore.hiddenSorrow: Kharok could not save the first ones who stood beside him. He remembers every name.
lore.knownRumor: Old warriors say the girdle grows heavier when its bearer lies to themselves.
lore.appearanceDormant: A rough iron-and-hide girdle marked with stone-like knots.
lore.appearanceAwakened: Hairline cracks glow like embers across the metal.
lore.appearanceExalted: The girdle feels weightless, though the ground trembles under its bearer.
lore.appearanceSignature: No visible change occurs; only the bearer knows the mountain has answered.

name: Chains of the Patron

notes: Primary workflow is Item Sheet -> Activities.
No player-facing macro is required.

theme: Power • Pact • Price • Will • Forbidden Choice

personality.roleplayGuidance: Mordrath does not lie. It lets the bearer decide how much truth they can afford.

moodMap.description: The chains hang cold and inert.
The bearer hears links moving when choices have a cost.
The chains frame every decision as a bargain.
The relic sees ambition with shape rather than hunger.
The pact between bearer and relic is nearly complete.
Mordrath reveals that the greatest price is knowing what one truly wants.

affinityEvents.label: Accepted a meaningful price for power
Outwitted a patron, fiend, or pact-bound enemy
Broke or twisted an unjust bargain
Protected someone's free will from a pact or curse
Claimed forbidden power without becoming its servant
Kept a bargain even when it became costly
Refused free power because the hidden cost was unacceptable
Submitted completely to a patron's demand without resistance
Broke your own sworn bargain carelessly
Used hard-won power for petty cruelty or vanity

hiddenRequirements.label: Refuse power offered without an honest price
Outwit a stronger patron, fiend, or pact-holder
Pay a meaningful cost yourself instead of passing it to an innocent
Name what you truly want and what you will not sacrifice for it

passives: Borrowed Power. Once per turn when you deal damage with Eldritch Blast, a pact weapon, or a warlock spell, add the relic bonus to one damage roll.

Read the Fine Print. You gain the relic bonus to Charisma (Deception), Charisma (Persuasion), and Intelligence (Arcana) checks related to pacts, fiends, patrons, contracts, curses, or forbidden magic.
Price Paid. When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, gain temporary hit points equal to your warlock level + the relic bonus.
No Master But the Price. You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, dominated, or magically compelled by patrons, fiends, celestials, or pact-bound entities.
actives: Patron's Glance. Bonus Action, 1 charge. Choose one creature within 60 feet. Until the end of your next turn, you sense whether it is bound by a pact, curse, oath, or extraplanar influence.
Borrowed Ruin. Special, 2 charges. Use when you hit with Eldritch Blast, a pact weapon, or a warlock spell. The attack or spell deals extra necrotic damage.

Chain of Binding. Action, 3 charges. A creature within 60 feet must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is restrained by spectral chains until the end of your next turn. Midi: Save Activity requests a STR save; apply Restrained through normal Foundry condition tools if the condition is not applied automatically.
Pay the Difference. Reaction, 4 charges. When you fail a saving throw, take necrotic damage equal to your warlock level to reroll the save. The new result must be used.
features.avatar: Avatar of the Pact. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. Black-gold chains orbit you. You gain flying speed 30 ft with hover, resistance to necrotic damage, and once per turn when you deal damage with Eldritch Blast, a pact weapon, or a warlock spell, you deal extra necrotic damage equal to your warlock level.
features.signature: Price of Eternity. Once per long rest. Choose a creature within 60 feet that can hear you. Offer a price approved by the GM. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it is restrained by Mordrath's chains for 1 minute and cannot benefit from teleportation or invisibility. Once during the duration, when it fails to escape, you may regain a spent warlock spell slot of 5th level or lower. Midi: Save Activity requests a CHA save; ongoing pact effects are GM/Midi dependent.

dreams.title: The Empty Contract
dreams.text: You sign your name on a blank page. The ink asks what you wanted before you wrote it.

dreams.title: The Thousand Chains
dreams.text: A thousand chains hang from a black sky. Each one whispers a different promise.

dreams.title: The Auction of Souls
dreams.text: No one bids coin. Everyone bids memories, names, and futures.

dreams.title: Mordrath
dreams.text: A figure in broken chains smiles without warmth. 'At last,' it says. 'You know what you are willing to pay.'

memories.title: The First Bargain
memories.text: Mordrath remembers the first mortal who asked for more than fate offered.

memories.title: The Price Unpaid
memories.text: Mordrath remembers the ruin caused by power taken as a gift.

memories.title: The Patron Outwitted
memories.text: A patron learned contracts can cut both ways.

memories.title: The Name Sold
memories.text: A warlock sold their name and forgot why they wanted power.

memories.title: The Final Clause
memories.text: The clause no one reads until the end.

positive: A fair price.
Now you understand value.
Power taken blindly owns the taker.
You paid with open eyes.
negative: Cheap.
You mistook hunger for ambition.
That was not a bargain. That was begging.
You sold what was not yours.
neutral: Nothing is free. Not even refusal.
signature: Paid in full.
The chain is not your prison. It is your signature.
Now bargain with eternity.

signatureCeremony.title: Mordrath Awakens
text: Every flame nearby burns black.
A chain coils around your wrist, but does not tighten.
A voice asks: What do you want?
You answer, and the world waits for the price.
The chain unlocks itself.
A name rings like metal on stone: Mordrath, The Price of Ambition.

lore.origin: Mordrath is the memory of the first mortal who demanded power and accepted that every gift must be paid for.
lore.hiddenSorrow: Mordrath once believed a bearer could take power without becoming cruel. It was wrong, and it remembers the cost.
lore.knownRumor: Warlocks whisper these chains do not belong to a patron. They belonged to someone who made patrons afraid.
lore.appearanceDormant: Short blackened chain links worn as a mantle, belt, or wrist wrap.
lore.appearanceAwakened: Gold script appears on the links whenever a bargain is spoken.
lore.appearanceExalted: The chains float weightlessly, never touching the ground.
lore.appearanceSignature: Every link bears a name, but the bearer can read only one: their own.

trueName.name: Sol'Kaer
trueName.title: The Shield That Never Fell
trueName.full: Sol'Kaer, The Shield That Never Fell

notes: Primary workflow is Item Sheet -> Activities.
No player-facing macro is required.
Relic text received the v0.24.1 cleanup pass; remaining table calls are marked in ability text.

likes: Standing between harm and the helpless
Holding the line when retreat is easier
personality.roleplayGuidance: Sol'Kaer rewards protectors who hold the line when retreat would be easier. It grows cold around selfish bravery and answers most strongly when the bearer shields another at real cost.

moodMap.description: A pale warmth gathers along the shield edge when danger turns toward the helpless.
The aegis answers with brief flashes of dawnlight when the bearer chooses duty over safety.
The aegis tests whether the bearer protects because it is right, not because glory is watching.
The relic steadies the bearer like a wall that remembers every life it sheltered.
The shield accepts the bearer as a last line between harm and the innocent.
Dawnlight collects at the bearer's arm; Sol'Kaer is ready to speak its true name.

hiddenRequirements.label: Save an ally from death three times.
Win a boss battle below 10 HP.
End a battle as the last one standing.

passives: Dawn's Endurance. During the first round of each combat, you gain a bonus to AC equal to the relic bonus.
Unbroken Wall. Opportunity attacks against allies within 5 feet of you have disadvantage.

Guardian's Burden. When a creature you can see attacks an ally within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to become the target of that attack instead. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses when you finish a long rest.
First Light. When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
actives: Stand Firm. Bonus Action, 1 charge. Until the start of your next turn, add the relic bonus to checks and saves made to resist being pushed, knocked prone, grappled, or restrained.
Dawn Barrier. Reaction, 2 charges. When an ally within 30 feet is hit by an attack, grant that ally +4 AC against the triggering attack, potentially turning the hit into a miss.
Bastion of Resolve. Action, 3 charges, 1 minute. You radiate a 10-foot aura. You and allies in the aura have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed.
Break the Darkness. Action, 4 charges. One fiend or undead within 30 feet must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes radiant damage and is blinded until the end of your next turn.
features.avatar: Dawn Incarnate. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. You shine with sunrise armor. You gain flying speed 30 feet with hover, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, shed bright light, and once per turn your weapon hit deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage.
features.signature: Last Sunrise. Once per long rest. Allies of your choice within 30 feet regain 30 hit points and end frightened and charmed. Until the end of your next turn, the first time each affected ally would drop to 0 hit points, they drop to 1 instead. You gain one level of exhaustion.

dreams.title: The White Field
dreams.text: You dream of a field of white ash under a sky with no sun. Somewhere behind you, someone small is breathing too fast. You wake with your arm raised, as if a shield were already on it.

dreams.title: The Broken Shield
dreams.text: A shield lies split in two across the threshold of a gate. Its bearer is gone, but the gate is still closed. A voice without warmth says: 'It held. That was enough.'

dreams.title: The Last Wall
dreams.text: You stand on a wall that crumbles stone by stone. Each time a stone falls, you step into the gap. Behind you, a city sleeps and never learns your name.

dreams.title: Sol'Kaer
dreams.text: Night ends. Light pours across a battlefield and finds a single figure still standing, shield raised against an enemy long gone. The figure turns, and it wears your face. 'I never fell,' it says. 'Neither will you.'

memories.title: The Last Wall
memories.text: Sol'Kaer remembers a wall of forty shields, and how it became thirty, then ten, then one. The last did not step back. The dark broke against it until dawn.

memories.title: A Child Behind the Shield
memories.text: Sol'Kaer remembers a child pressed against its bearer's back, too frightened to cry. Every blow that night landed on the shield, so that none landed on her.

memories.title: The Day the Sun Did Not Rise
memories.text: Sol'Kaer remembers a morning that never came, when the dark held the sky for three days. Its bearer kept the watch fire burning and told no one how afraid they were.

memories.title: Sol'Kaer's Final Stand
memories.text: Sol'Kaer remembers its first bearer's last breath at the gate, and the sunrise that came a moment too late for them to see it. The gate held. The aegis has carried that sunrise ever since.

positive: You stood. That is all I ask.
They are alive because you did not move.
The line held.
A shield is measured by what it keeps, not by what it breaks.
Dawn is closer than it was.
negative: You stepped aside. Someone else paid for it.
A shield that runs is only metal.
They called for you. You were elsewhere.
Glory is a poor reason to stand. You chose it anyway.
The gate is open behind you.
neutral: Watch the gap, not the enemy.
A wall is only as strong as the one who will not leave it.
The night is long. So is my patience.
signature: I am Sol'Kaer. I have never fallen.
Stand with me, and morning will find us both.
Let the dark come. We have outlasted it before.

signatureCeremony.title: Sol'Kaer Awakens
text: The light changes, as if the sun has chosen to rise early for you alone.
Your shield arm grows warm, then heavy, then certain.
For a heartbeat you see them all: every bearer who stood at a gate and did not step back.
They do not speak. One by one, they lower their shields in salute.
A voice like a bell struck at dawn says:
You held when holding cost you everything.
Now nothing will make you fall.
The true name settles over you like morning light: Sol'Kaer, The Shield That Never Fell.

lore.origin: Sol'Kaer was forged in the long night before the first sunrise, when a single shield-bearer held a gate against the dark until morning came. The aegis is what remained of that vigil: a promise that someone will always stand between harm and the helpless.
lore.hiddenSorrow: Sol'Kaer remembers the fortress gate that held until dawn, and the one child its bearer could not reach.
lore.knownRumor: Old soldiers say the aegis appears only before sieges where one stand can change a generation.
lore.appearanceDormant: A white-gold shield boss or bracer plate, warm only when someone nearby is afraid.
lore.appearanceAwakened: Hairline sunbursts spread across its surface whenever the bearer interposes themself.
lore.appearanceExalted: A rim of dawnfire burns around the aegis without heat, throwing long shadows behind enemies.
lore.appearanceSignature: The shield becomes a disk of first light, translucent at the edges and heavy with remembered vows.

trueName.name: Aurex
trueName.title: The Crown That United Kings
trueName.full: Aurex, The Crown That United Kings

likes: Orders that protect the ones who obey them
personality.corePhrase: A crown is carried, never worn.
personality.roleplayGuidance: Aurex respects authority earned through service, restraint, and accountability. It rejects domination for vanity and asks whether followers become stronger beneath the bearer's command.

moodMap.description: The crown is heavy and silent, measuring whether the bearer commands themself first.
A low golden resonance follows promises kept and orders that protect rather than exploit.
The crown tests the bearer with hard choices between pride, mercy, and responsibility.
The crown recognizes a voice that can lead without needing to crush dissent.
The relic accepts the bearer as one who can carry power without being consumed by it.
A ring of invisible courtiers falls silent; Aurex is ready to speak its true name.

hiddenRequirements.label: Gain voluntary support of five NPCs.
Take responsibility for an ally's mistake.

passives: Crowned Smite. When you deal damage with Divine Smite, it deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage plus the relic bonus.

Banner of Order. When combat begins, choose a number of allies within 30 feet of you equal to your proficiency bonus. Each gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + the relic bonus.
King's Mercy. When you roll initiative, you regain a number of hit points in your Lay on Hands pool equal to five times the relic bonus.

Commander's Resolve. When an ally you can see within 30 feet fails a saving throw, you can use your reaction to let them reroll it; they must use the new roll. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses when you finish a long rest.
actives: Crown's Judgment. No action, 1 charge, once per turn. When you hit a creature with a melee attack, the crown passes judgment, and the target takes an extra 3d8 radiant damage.
Royal Decree. Bonus Action, 2 charges. One creature within 60 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is compelled by your command until the end of your next turn.
Divine Mandate. No action, 3 charges. You regain one expended use of Channel Divinity.
March of Kings. Bonus Action, 4 charges. Choose allies within 30 feet who can hear you. Each can use its reaction to move up to half its speed or make one weapon attack.
features.avatar: King Eternal. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. A spectral mantle and crown form around you. You gain a flying speed of 30 feet and can hover, you have resistance to psychic damage, your melee weapon hits deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage, and the radius of your Aura of Protection increases by 10 feet.
features.signature: The World Shall Kneel. Once per long rest. Enemies of your choice within 60 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature is frightened, knocked prone, reduced to speed 0, and cannot take reactions for 1 minute.

dreams.title: The Empty Throne
dreams.text: You dream of a throne room with no walls. A throne stands empty at its center, and every person you have ever given an order to stands waiting before it. None of them look at the throne. They are all looking at you.

dreams.title: The Broken City
dreams.text: A city burns under a banner that is yours. You did not light the fire, but the soldiers who did are wearing your colors. A crowned shadow asks you a single question: 'Whose fault is this?'

dreams.title: The Earned Crown
dreams.text: You kneel in mud beside a wounded stranger and bind their wounds with your own cloak. When you rise, a circle of kneeling people surrounds you. Nobody told them to kneel.

dreams.title: Aurex
dreams.text: A hundred broken crowns lie in a hall of dust. As you walk past, they rise and fit themselves together, point by point, into a single crown of gold. It does not descend onto your head. It waits for you to reach for it, and asks if you are certain.

memories.title: The Empty Throne
memories.text: Aurex remembers a throne left empty for a full year, because no claimant would swear to serve the people before themselves. The kingdom endured that year better than any before it.

memories.title: The Last King
memories.text: Aurex remembers a king who walked into the enemy camp alone and unarmed to end a war his pride had started. He did not come back. The war ended that night.

memories.title: When Crowns Were Earned
memories.text: Aurex remembers an age when rulers were chosen by the people who had followed them through famine and flood. In that age, every crown was heavy, and no one wanted one.

memories.title: The First Kingdom
memories.text: Aurex remembers the first kingdom: twelve villages that chose to stand together against the dark. Their first law had five words. No one rules the unwilling.

positive: They followed because they chose to. Remember that.
That is how a ruler answers.
You carried the weight. Good.
Mercy from the strong is law. Mercy from the weak is a plea.
Your word held. So will they.
negative: Obedience is not loyalty.
You commanded from the back of the field.
A crown of fear rusts quickly.
They followed you into that. Answer for it.
You spoke as a master, not a sovereign.
neutral: A crown is carried, never worn.
Who serves the one who rules?
Silence in the ranks is not agreement.
signature: I am Aurex. Kings have knelt to me. I have knelt to none of them.
You have earned the right to command. Now earn it again tomorrow.
Rise, sovereign. They are waiting for you.

signatureCeremony.title: Aurex Awakens
text: Every voice nearby falls silent at once.
A weight settles on your brow. There is nothing there, yet you could not lift it alone.
Around you rise the shapes of kings and queens long dead, each wearing a broken crown.
They do not bow. They watch, as a court watches a verdict.
Then a voice of gold and iron speaks:
You commanded, and they were not diminished.
You ruled, and you served.
The crowns join into one, and its true name rings through you: Aurex, The Crown That United Kings.

lore.origin: Aurex was first worn by the leader of twelve villages who chose to stand together against the dark, and it has judged every ruler since. It does not care whether a bearer is born to rule. It cares only whether the people beneath their command become stronger or smaller.
lore.hiddenSorrow: Aurex remembers the first kingdom splitting because its king chose obedience over trust.
lore.knownRumor: Bards claim the crown refuses any ruler who cannot kneel beside the people they command.
lore.appearanceDormant: A tarnished circlet fragment or command medallion that feels heavier when orders are cruel.
lore.appearanceAwakened: Tiny script appears along the rim, recording oaths freely given.
lore.appearanceExalted: A phantom crown hovers above the bearer in moments of command, visible only in reflected light.
lore.appearanceSignature: Aurex becomes a full golden crown of many joined crowns, each point shaped like a raised standard.

personality.corePhrase: The dragon is the breath, not the fire.
personality.roleplayGuidance: Ryushen values discipline without cruelty and strength without performance. It answers practice, patience, restraint, and victories earned after failure.

moodMap.description: The bands rest like cool stone, waiting for breath and motion to align.
A slow pulse follows moments when the bearer chooses patience over impulse.
The bands test whether control remains when pain, insult, or fear breaks rhythm.
The bands move with the bearer, correcting wasted motion before thought catches up.
The relic accepts the bearer as a student who can become the lesson.
A dragon exhales inside the bearer's breath; Ryushen is ready to speak its true name.

hiddenRequirements.label: Take no damage in three combats.
Defeat someone after losing to them.
Spend a long rest in silence.

passives: Dragon's Grip. You can grapple a creature of any size up to Huge. A creature grappled by you has disadvantage on checks it makes to escape the grapple, and moving a creature you are grappling costs you no extra movement.

Breath Between Blows. Once per turn, when a creature fails a saving throw against one of your Monk features (such as Stunning Strike) or against your Grapple or Shove, you regain 1 Focus Point. You can use this feature a number of times equal to the relic bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a short or long rest.
Dragon Hide. Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to your Monk level.
Dragon's Fang. Your Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapon attacks deal extra force damage equal to the relic bonus.
actives: Dragon Seizes. Reaction, 1 charge. When a creature within your reach moves away from you or misses you with a melee attack, you make an Unarmed Strike against it using the Grapple option.
Still Breath. Bonus Action, 2 charges. You regain Focus Points equal to the relic bonus + 1.
Coiled Scales. Reaction, 3 charges. When you are hit by an attack, your AC increases by 5 until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack.
Perfect Strike. No action, 4 charges, once per turn. When you hit a creature, it takes extra force damage equal to four rolls of your Martial Arts die.
features.avatar: Inner Dragon Manifest. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. A translucent dragon coils around your limbs. You gain a flying speed of 40 feet and can hover, your reach increases by 5 feet, and your Unarmed Strike hits deal an extra 1d10 force damage. You can grapple two creatures at once, and a creature grappled by you takes force damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die at the start of each of its turns. You regain 1 Focus Point at the start of each of your turns.
features.signature: Dragon Unbound. Once per long rest, 1 minute. You regain all expended Focus Points, and your Monk features cost 1 fewer Focus Point (minimum 0). You have resistance to all damage except psychic damage, you can't be grappled, restrained, or stunned, and your Unarmed Strikes score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

dreams.title: The Silent Mountain
dreams.text: You dream of a mountain so quiet that you can hear your own heartbeat echo from the peaks. You try to climb it and fall. You try again and fall again. On the third attempt, you notice the steps were carved there for you all along.

dreams.title: The Meditating Dragon
dreams.text: A dragon lies coiled on a temple roof, perfectly still, eyes closed. Arrows strike its scales and fall away. It does not wake. When the archers tire and leave, it opens one eye and looks at you as if to ask whether you understood.

dreams.title: The Bow Within
dreams.text: You stand in an empty courtyard and strike the air a thousand times. On the thousandth strike there is no sound, no wind, no effort. There is only the strike, and for a moment, you are not there at all.

dreams.title: Ryushen
dreams.text: Chains fall from your wrists, but you do not move. A great silver dragon uncoils from your own breath and circles you once. 'You could always have broken them,' it says. 'You learned to wait until breaking them meant something.'

memories.title: The Mountain That Waited
memories.text: Ryushen remembers a student who climbed the same mountain path every dawn for twenty years. The mountain never changed. The student did.

memories.title: One Thousand Strikes
memories.text: Ryushen remembers a thousand strikes against a temple pillar, and the morning the pillar was left untouched because the student finally understood when not to strike.

memories.title: The Silent Dragon
memories.text: Ryushen remembers a dragon that let itself be called a coward rather than burn a valley that had insulted it. Its stillness saved more lives than any battle it ever fought.

memories.title: The Perfect Breath
memories.text: Ryushen remembers a single breath, drawn in a burning temple, slow and complete. In that breath its bearer chose to carry the children out rather than chase the arsonist.

positive: Again. Better.
You did not need to strike. So you didn't.
That was discipline, not hesitation.
Pain passed through you and left you standing.
You lost, and you learned. That is the only victory that lasts.
negative: You fought the anger, and it won.
Who was that strike for? The enemy or the crowd?
Wasted motion. Wasted breath.
The defeated were already beaten. You struck them anyway.
You skipped the practice. The fight noticed.
neutral: The dragon is the breath, not the fire.
A closed fist is still an open choice.
Mastery is the same lesson, learned forever.
signature: I am Ryushen. I wore chains so that I would learn to choose.
We move as one now. Do not mistake that for ease.
Unbound does not mean unrestrained.

signatureCeremony.title: Ryushen Awakens
text: Your breath slows until the world seems to slow with it.
The bands grow warm, then weightless, then gone, though you can still feel them on your wrists.
Behind your eyes, a silver dragon uncoils from a long, patient sleep.
It does not roar. It breathes once, in time with you.
A voice as calm as still water says:
You were strong enough to break your chains long ago.
You waited until you were wise enough to deserve it.
The true name moves through you like a perfect breath: Ryushen, The Dragon Without Chains.

lore.origin: Ryushen was born when a dragon chose to bind its own power rather than let its rage burn the world, and gave its chains to a mortal student so that the lesson would not be lost. The bands teach the same lesson still: true strength is the power to hold back.
lore.hiddenSorrow: Ryushen remembers the master who won every duel but failed to teach mercy before the temple burned.
lore.knownRumor: Monks say the bands tighten when worn for display and loosen only after honest practice.
lore.appearanceDormant: Plain iron training bands, perfectly balanced and almost impossible to scratch.
lore.appearanceAwakened: Scale-like seams appear when the bearer breathes slowly through pain.
lore.appearanceExalted: A faint dragon silhouette follows the bearer's movements half a heartbeat late.
lore.appearanceSignature: The bands become living rings of silver scale and warm breath, weightless until violence begins.

trueName.name: Noctyra
trueName.title: The Shadow That Never Slept
trueName.full: Noctyra, The Shadow That Never Slept

notes: Primary workflow is Item Sheet -> Activities.
No player-facing macro is required.
Relic text received the v0.24.1 cleanup pass; remaining table calls are marked in ability text.

likes: Plans that end danger before it begins
Mercy no one ever learns about
Protecting those who never knew they were in danger
personality.corePhrase: The best blade is the one never drawn.
personality.roleplayGuidance: Noctyra rewards patience, information, and clean plans that end danger before panic begins. It distrusts spectacle, needless lies, and cruelty disguised as cleverness.

moodMap.description: The cloak drinks light silently, waiting to see whether the bearer can wait as well.
Its hem stirs toward hidden exits when the bearer gathers information before acting.
The cloak tests plans by offering tempting shortcuts that would expose the innocent.
The cloak trusts the bearer enough to hide their heartbeat from listening shadows.
The relic accepts the bearer as a blade that can remain sheathed until the right moment.
Every shadow turns its face toward the bearer; Noctyra is ready to speak its true name.

hiddenRequirements.label: Defeat a boss through a plan.

passives: Shadow Walker. You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while you are in dim light or darkness.
Veil of Silence. Your movement makes no sound, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to detect hidden creatures.
One With Darkness. While you are in dim light or darkness, you gain a +2 bonus to AC.
Unseen Hunter. You have advantage on the first attack roll you make in each combat. If that attack hits, it deals an extra 2d8 necrotic damage.
actives: Shadow Step. Bonus Action, 1 charge. Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness that you can see.
Fade Away. Reaction, 2 charges. When you are targeted by an attack or effect, become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack or cast a spell.
Living Darkness. Action, 3 charges. Create a zone of magical darkness at a point within 60 feet. The bearer can see through this darkness.
Death From Silence. Action, 4 charges. Make a weapon attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, deal an extra 8d6 necrotic damage; the GM may call for a save to resist being stunned.
features.avatar: Walker Between Shadows. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. You gain flying speed 40 feet with hover, resistance to necrotic damage, may become invisible as a bonus action in dim light or darkness, and your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.
features.signature: One Step Behind. Once per long rest, 1 minute. At the start of each of your turns, you may teleport to a shadow within 60 feet. The first attack you make after each teleport has advantage and deals an extra 10d6 necrotic damage on a hit.

dreams.title: The City Without Moonlight
dreams.text: You dream of a city where the moon never rises. People walk its streets without lanterns, guided by whispers from the walls. One whisper speaks your name, then falls silent, as if it said too much.

dreams.title: The Crown Not Taken
dreams.text: A crown rests on a velvet cushion in an unguarded room. You could take it and no one would ever know. You leave it, and as you close the door, a shadow behind you laughs softly in approval.

dreams.title: The Speaking Shadows
dreams.text: Shadows gather around a table and speak to each other in low voices. They are planning something. When you sit down among them, they slide a map toward you and wait for your first move.

dreams.title: Noctyra
dreams.text: Every shadow in the world turns to face you at once. From the darkness steps a figure made of folded night, eyes like distant stars. 'I have watched you in every dark room,' it says. 'You never once wasted the dark.'

memories.title: The City Without Light
memories.text: Noctyra remembers a city under siege where every lamp went dark on the same night. By dawn the enemy commanders were gone, the gates were open, and not one citizen had been harmed.

memories.title: When Silence Won
memories.text: Noctyra remembers a war that ended without a battle, because a single letter reached the right hands at the right hour. No song was written about it. That was the point.

memories.title: The Unseen Queen
memories.text: Noctyra remembers a queen who ruled for forty years without anyone learning her face. She walked among her people in the dark and knew their troubles better than any crowned king.

memories.title: The Last Shadow
memories.text: Noctyra remembers its first bearer slipping away into the dark after saving a kingdom, leaving no name behind. The kingdom never thanked them. The cloak has never forgotten them.

positive: Clean. No one will ever know.
You waited. That was the hardest part.
They never saw you coming. They never needed to.
Information is the sharpest blade.
You let them keep their secret. Wise.
negative: That was noise, not a plan.
You lied when the truth would have served.
Everyone saw that. Everyone will remember.
Cruelty is not cleverness. It only looks like it in the dark.
You sold someone who trusted you.
neutral: The best blade is the one never drawn.
Patience is a dagger held very still.
signature: I am Noctyra. I have never slept.
Wherever there is shadow, you are home now.
Let them search the dark. They will find only us.

signatureCeremony.title: Noctyra Awakens
text: The light around you dims, though no flame has gone out.
Every shadow in the room leans toward you, as if it has been waiting to be noticed.
The cloak grows heavy with the weight of a thousand kept secrets.
Faces form in the folds: bearers who saved cities and were never thanked.
One of them leans close and whispers:
You learned to be unseen without becoming cruel.
Now the dark will hide you, and you will guard the dark.
The true name settles into you without a sound: Noctyra, The Shadow That Never Slept.

lore.origin: Noctyra was woven from the first night that ever kept a secret: the darkness in which a hunted people hid from those who would destroy them. The cloak still remembers what shadows are for. They are not for cruelty. They are for shelter.
lore.hiddenSorrow: Noctyra remembers the night a perfect plan saved a kingdom and left its planner forgotten in the dark.
lore.knownRumor: Thieves whisper that the cloak chooses those who know when not to strike.
lore.appearanceDormant: A matte black cloak clasp or strip of fabric that never catches torchlight directly.
lore.appearanceAwakened: Its folds show impossible depth, as if a second room waits inside the cloth.
lore.appearanceExalted: Shadows cling to the bearer like loyal informants, bending away from allies.
lore.appearanceSignature: The cloak becomes a starless sky draped over the shoulders, with silent footsteps moving inside it.

trueName.name: Eldryss
trueName.title: The Heart That Never Withered
trueName.full: Eldryss, The Heart That Never Withered

notes: Primary workflow is Item Sheet -> Activities.
No player-facing macro is required.
Relic text received the v0.24.1 cleanup pass; remaining table calls are marked in ability text.

likes: Planting what you will never see grow
personality.corePhrase: What is planted in grief may still bloom.
personality.roleplayGuidance: Eldryss honors growth that preserves balance: healing, restoration, mercy, and patient renewal. It withers around wasteful destruction or life taken for convenience.

moodMap.description: A dry seed-heart waits in silence, listening for compassion beneath the bearer's choices.
Tiny green veins wake across the relic when the bearer restores what others would abandon.
The heart tests whether mercy can survive hunger, anger, and fear of loss.
The heart beats with the bearer's pulse and steadies wounded creatures nearby.
The relic accepts the bearer as soil where ruined things may grow again.
Roots coil through dream and bone; Eldryss is ready to speak its true name.

passives: Living Sap. When you finish a long rest, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice your proficiency bonus.
Nature's Blessing. Whenever you regain hit points from a spell, potion, or feature, you regain additional hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

Endless Spring. The first time an ally within 30 feet of you drops to 0 hit points, they drop to 1 hit point instead. Once this feature saves an ally, it can't do so again until you finish a long rest.
World Tree's Gift. You are immune to the poisoned condition and to disease.
actives: Verdant Bloom. Action, 1 charge. Cause plants and roots to surge in an area within 60 feet. Enemies treat the area as difficult terrain while allies move through it normally.
Nature's Embrace. Bonus Action, 2 charges. A creature within 30 feet regains 4d8 hit points.
Forest Guardian. Action, 3 charges, 1 minute. You project a protective growth aura. Allies in the aura gain resistance to one damage type chosen by the GM from the current threat.
Roots of Eternity. Action, 4 charges. A creature within 60 feet must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is restrained by ancient roots for 1 minute.
features.avatar: Avatar of Yggdrasil. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. Branches and living light surround you. You gain flying speed 30 feet with hover, resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison damage, and allies who start their turn near you regain hit points equal to the relic bonus.
features.signature: World Reborn. Once per long rest. Allies of your choice within 60 feet regain all hit points, end poisoned and diseased, and reduce exhaustion by 1. Enemies chosen by the GM in the renewal surge take 8d8 radiant or force damage.

dreams.title: The Leafless Tree
dreams.text: You dream of a vast tree without a single leaf, standing in a field of grey dust. You lay your palm on its bark and feel, deep beneath your hand, something still beating. Very slowly. Very faintly.

dreams.title: The First Leaf
dreams.text: A single green leaf opens on a dead branch above you. It trembles in a wind you cannot feel. Below it, in the dust, the first blade of grass pushes up toward the light.

dreams.title: The Wind Voice
dreams.text: The wind moves through a forest that has not yet grown, and you can hear it singing through branches that will exist in a hundred years. The song is about you, and it is not finished.

dreams.title: Eldryss
dreams.text: You stand within the trunk of the first world-tree, surrounded by the heartbeat of every forest that ever lived. A voice like rain on new leaves says: 'Everything you healed is still growing. Come and see.'

memories.title: The First Seed
memories.text: Eldryss remembers the first seed, planted in ash by a druid who had lost everything to fire. She never lived to see it sprout. It became the first forest of the new world.

memories.title: Roots Beneath the Stars
memories.text: Eldryss remembers roots that reached beneath the whole world, holding the land together through an age of earthquakes. No one saw them. Everything stood because of them.

memories.title: When Forests Sang
memories.text: Eldryss remembers an age when the forests sang aloud and every traveler could understand them. The song ended when the first forest was cut down for profit. Some trees still remember the melody.

memories.title: The Last Spring
memories.text: Eldryss remembers a winter that lasted nine years, and the single spring flower its bearer kept alive in their hands through all of it. When the thaw came, that flower seeded a valley.

positive: It will grow back. Because of you.
You healed what others left to die.
That was a seed. Be patient with it.
Life answers life.
The roots felt that.
negative: That did not need to die.
You burned what you could have healed.
Ash remembers.
You took and gave nothing back.
Something withered just now. It was not only the grass.
neutral: What is planted in grief may still bloom.
Growth is slow. So is healing.
Water the roots, not the leaves.
signature: I am Eldryss. I have never withered.
Wherever you walk now, something will grow.
Grief and growth share the same roots. You know that now.

signatureCeremony.title: Eldryss Awakens
text: The ground beneath your feet grows warm, and the air smells of rain.
Green threads spread from your hands into the earth, and the earth answers.
All around you, things that should not bloom are blooming: stone, rust, ash.
You feel the slow heartbeat of every forest at once, and your own heart slows to match it.
A voice like wind through a canopy says:
You healed what the world gave up on.
Now the world will grow wherever you walk.
The true name takes root in you: Eldryss, The Heart That Never Withered.

lore.origin: Eldryss is the heartwood of the first world-tree, from whose roots every forest grew. It carries the memory of every forest that grew from its roots, and every forest that was lost. It asks only one thing of its bearers: to plant more than they take.
lore.hiddenSorrow: Eldryss remembers the first world-tree losing a single branch to save a burning forest below.
lore.knownRumor: Druids say the heart blooms only for those who understand that growth and grief share roots.
lore.appearanceDormant: A petrified seed or heartwood charm with one living green line at its center.
lore.appearanceAwakened: Leaves grow from it overnight and fade into light when plucked.
lore.appearanceExalted: A miniature canopy of spectral branches spreads behind the bearer in moments of healing.
lore.appearanceSignature: The heart becomes a living knot of root, leaf, and starlight, beating with the rhythm of distant forests.

trueName.name: Seraphel
trueName.title: The Light That Refused to Fade
trueName.full: Seraphel, The Light That Refused to Fade

notes: Primary workflow is Item Sheet -> Activities.
No player-facing macro is required.
Relic text received the v0.24.1 cleanup pass; remaining table calls are marked in ability text.

temperament: Fierce in defense of the suffering
likes: Hope offered when it seems foolish
personality.corePhrase: Light is only light if it reaches the dark.
personality.roleplayGuidance: Seraphel answers faith expressed through mercy, courage, and service rather than doctrine alone. It dims when healing is withheld for pride or compassion is treated as weakness.

moodMap.description: The vestments hang still, smelling faintly of candle smoke after prayers for the wounded.
Threaded light appears along the seams when the bearer comforts someone with no reward promised.
The vestments test whether faith remains when miracles are delayed and pain is inconvenient.
The relic trusts the bearer with warmth that steadies frightened hands.
The vestments accept the bearer as a servant of light before victory.
A choir too distant to hear gathers in the cloth; Seraphel is ready to speak its true name.

hiddenRequirements.label: Bring an ally back from death.
Be the last healer in a disaster.

passives: Gentle Light. Allies within 30 feet of you have advantage on death saving throws.
Saint's Grace. When you restore hit points to a creature with a spell or feature, it regains additional hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.
Beacon of Hope. Allies within 30 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.
Unyielding Spirit. When a spell or effect would kill you outright, you can reject it and drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
actives: Blessing. Bonus Action, 1 charge. An ally within 30 feet adds 1d4 to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks until the end of your next turn.
Cleansing Light. Action, 2 charges. End one poison, disease, frightened, or charmed condition affecting a creature within 30 feet.
Sanctuary of Dawn. Action, 3 charges, 1 minute. You create a 10-foot aura of sanctuary. Allies in the aura gain resistance to necrotic and radiant damage.
Wings of Mercy. Action, 4 charges. Up to three allies within 60 feet each regain 6d8 hit points. Wings of light carry the healing around cover at the GM's discretion.
features.avatar: Saint Incarnate. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. Wings and vestments of light form around you. You gain flying speed 40 feet with hover, resistance to radiant damage, shed bright light, and allies near you regain hit points equal to the relic bonus at the start of their turns.
features.signature: Miracle of the First Saint. Once per long rest. Allies of your choice within 60 feet are fully healed and cleansed of poison, disease, frightened, charmed, paralyzed, and stunned. One ally who died within the last minute may return to life at 1 hit point.

dreams.title: The Empty Temple
dreams.text: You dream of an empty temple. Its altar is bare and its candles are cold. Outside its doors, someone is crying in the rain. The temple does not move toward them. You do.

dreams.title: The Wounded Field
dreams.text: You walk across a battlefield after the fighting has ended. The wounded call out in a dozen languages, some in your own, some in the enemy's. In the dream you cannot tell which is which, and you realize it does not matter.

dreams.title: The Light Returns
dreams.text: A long night ends. The first ray of dawn falls not on a cathedral, but on a small hut where someone has been keeping vigil beside a sick child. The child opens their eyes.

dreams.title: Seraphel
dreams.text: You stand in a field of light so bright you should not be able to see, yet you see everything. A figure in white-gold robes kneels before you and takes your hands. 'You carried the light into places it had never been,' they say. 'Now let it carry you.'

memories.title: The First Prayer
memories.text: Seraphel remembers the first prayer it ever heard. It was not for wealth or victory. It was a mother asking that her child's fever break, and promising nothing in return.

memories.title: When Hope Returned
memories.text: Seraphel remembers a plague city where no healer would enter, and the one who walked through its gates anyway. They saved few, but for the first time in months, the city stopped despairing.

memories.title: The Empty Cathedral
memories.text: Seraphel remembers a grand cathedral emptied by its own priests when the war reached its doors. Its bearer stayed behind and turned the nave into a hospital for both armies.

memories.title: Light Beyond Death
memories.text: Seraphel remembers holding the hand of a dying soldier who feared the dark. It shone a little brighter so that the last thing the soldier saw was light.

positive: They will live. Because you stayed.
That mercy was not owed. You gave it anyway.
The light reached further today.
You healed an enemy. Few understand how holy that is.
Hope is lighter when it is shared.
negative: You could have healed them. You chose not to.
Faith without mercy is only noise.
You turned away. The light did not follow you.
They needed you, not your sermon.
Pride is a poor reason to let someone suffer.
neutral: Light is only light if it reaches the dark.
Mercy first. Judgment later, if at all.
Even a candle defies the night.
Every wound is a prayer someone cannot say aloud.
signature: I am Seraphel. I refused to fade.
Wherever you walk, the dark will remember being lit.
Rise, saint. There is so much left to heal.

signatureCeremony.title: Seraphel Awakens
text: Warmth spreads through you, like the first sun after a long winter.
The vestments stir without wind, and light gathers in their folds.
You hear voices, thousands of them, every person ever healed by a bearer of this cloth.
They are not praising you. They are thanking you.
A voice as soft as a hand on a fevered brow says:
You brought light where no one else would go.
Now the light will never leave you.
The true name blooms in your heart: Seraphel, The Light That Refused to Fade.

lore.origin: Seraphel was woven from the robes of the first healer to walk onto a battlefield and tend the wounded of both sides. No temple claims to have sent that healer, and every temple claims them now. The vestments remember only that they went where they were needed.
lore.hiddenSorrow: Seraphel remembers the saint who spent their final miracle on an enemy child and died unnamed.
lore.knownRumor: Temples disagree about Seraphel's doctrine, but every story agrees the vestments move toward suffering.
lore.appearanceDormant: A strip of white-gold cloth or stole that never stains where blood touches it.
lore.appearanceAwakened: Soft script appears in the weave after acts of mercy, then vanishes by dawn.
lore.appearanceExalted: A halo of cloth and light trails the bearer, folding itself around the wounded.
lore.appearanceSignature: The vestments become radiant robes of impossible softness, stitched with prayers in every known tongue.

trueName.name: Vorathis
trueName.title: The Flame That Refused Extinction
trueName.full: Vorathis, The Flame That Refused Extinction

notes: Primary workflow is Item Sheet -> Activities.
No player-facing macro is required.
Relic text received the v0.24.1 cleanup pass; remaining table calls are marked in ability text.

temperament: Scornful of cowardice and tyranny alike
dislikes: Begging for mercy one never offered
personality.corePhrase: Fire must choose what it burns.
personality.roleplayGuidance: Vorathis respects will that endures without surrendering to mindless destruction. It burns hotter when the bearer chooses purpose over rage and accepts the cost of power.

moodMap.description: The blood is dark and still, waiting to learn what the bearer will burn for.
Heat rises beneath the relic when the bearer refuses fear without lashing out blindly.
The dragon-blood tests whether the bearer can carry wrath without becoming its servant.
The relic trusts the bearer with a controlled flame that answers breath and heartbeat.
The dragon-blood accepts the bearer as one whose will can survive its own fire.
A first flame coils behind the bearer's eyes; Vorathis is ready to speak its true name.

passives: Wellspring. When you roll initiative, you regain Sorcery Points equal to the relic bonus.
Draconic Blood. Your hit point maximum increases by 1 for each of your character levels.

Twin Heart. Once per turn, you can apply a Metamagic option that costs 1 Sorcery Point without spending it. You can use this feature a number of times equal to the relic bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a long rest.
Elemental Wrath. Once per turn, when a sorcerer spell you cast deals damage, add your Charisma modifier + the relic bonus to one damage roll of that spell.
actives: Kindled Sorcery. No action, 1 charge. You regain one expended use of Innate Sorcery.
Burning Blood. Bonus Action, 2 charges, 1 minute. Your weapon and spell attacks deal an extra 2d6 fire damage once per turn.
Blood Tithe. Bonus Action, 3 charges. The first dragon's blood surges through you, and you regain Sorcery Points equal to the relic bonus + 2.
Primordial Breath. Action, 4 charges. Exhale a 60-foot cone of primordial fire. Creatures in the area make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
features.avatar: First Dragon Incarnate. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. You gain flying speed 80 feet with hover, resistance to fire, cold, and lightning damage, a frightful draconic presence, and once per turn your damage deals an extra 2d10 fire, cold, or lightning damage. While it lasts, your Metamagic options cost 1 fewer Sorcery Point (minimum 0).
features.signature: Heart of the First Flame. Once per long rest, 1 minute. You regain all expended Sorcery Points. You gain flying speed, resistance to all damage, advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, and your weapon and spell attacks score critical hits on a 19 or 20. When it ends, you gain one level of exhaustion.

dreams.title: The Lone Sky
dreams.text: You dream of an empty sky, wider than any you have seen. You are flying, alone, and there is nothing above you and nothing ahead. It is not peaceful. It is lonely, and the loneliness has teeth.

dreams.title: The Burning Heart
dreams.text: Your heart beats so loudly that the mountains answer. Each beat sends heat through your veins until you are sure you will burn up. You do not. You learn, slowly, to beat in rhythm with the fire.

dreams.title: The First Flame
dreams.text: A great dragon breathes fire over a frozen world. It does not destroy. The ice melts, rivers run, and green things wake. The dragon looks at you and asks: 'Do you understand now what fire is for?'

dreams.title: Vorathis
dreams.text: Chains of black iron are offered to a dragon on a burning mountain. It refuses them and burns rather than bow. From its ashes rises a single flame, and the flame turns toward you. 'I refused to end,' it says. 'So will you.'

memories.title: The First Flame
memories.text: Vorathis remembers the first flame in the world, small and frightened in the cold. The first dragon breathed on it, and it grew. Every fire since then has carried a little of that breath.

memories.title: Before Dragons Ruled
memories.text: Vorathis remembers an age before dragons were kings, when they were only the largest things that dared to fly. They earned the sky one storm at a time.

memories.title: Wings Against the Void
memories.text: Vorathis remembers a dragon flying straight into the dark between the stars to stop something vast from entering the world. It came back with its wings in tatters. The sky was still there.

memories.title: The Burning Sky
memories.text: Vorathis remembers a sky set on fire by dragons fighting over who would rule. The first dragon did not join them. It flew below, carrying the ones who were fleeing the flames.

positive: You did not yield. Good.
That fire had a purpose.
You fell. You rose. That is the whole lesson.
Power, chosen with care, is not a curse.
The blood is warm tonight.
negative: You were afraid, and you let it decide.
That fire burned for nothing.
You raised your strength against the weak. Disgraceful.
Rage is not power. It is surrender.
You wasted what a dragon died to give you.
neutral: Fire must choose what it burns.
Strength is a debt. Know who holds it.
The sky is wide enough for both of us.
signature: I am Vorathis. I refused extinction.
We burn together now. Choose well what we burn.
Let them bring their chains. We have refused chains before.

signatureCeremony.title: Vorathis Awakens
text: Heat rises in your blood, but it does not burn. It sings.
Your heartbeat thunders, and for a moment you hear another beating beside it, vast and ancient.
Shadows of great wings unfold across the ground around you.
You feel the memory of a mountain burning, and a will that would not bow.
A voice like a forge roaring to life speaks:
You carried fire without becoming ash.
You chose what to burn, and what to spare.
The true name ignites within you: Vorathis, The Flame That Refused Extinction.

lore.origin: Vorathis is the last ember of the first dragon, the first creature to fly and the first to refuse a master. Its blood carries that refusal. It will lend its fire to any bearer brave enough to wield it, but it will never serve a tyrant.
lore.hiddenSorrow: Vorathis remembers the first dragon choosing extinction over chains, and the mountain that became its pyre.
lore.knownRumor: Sorcerers say the blood refuses cowards and tyrants in equal measure; both waste fire.
lore.appearanceDormant: A ruby-dark vial, scale, or vein-like gem that warms near open flame.
lore.appearanceAwakened: The relic pulses like a second heart when the bearer refuses fear.
lore.appearanceExalted: Draconic script burns beneath its surface, visible through smoke and battle heat.
lore.appearanceSignature: The blood becomes liquid starlit flame, circling the bearer like a dragon around its hoard.
