personality.corePhrase: Every silence is waiting for a song.
personality.roleplayGuidance: Elyndor honors creation that gives courage, memory, and shape to hope. It falls silent around mockery that breaks spirits or art used only to manipulate the vulnerable.

moodMap.description: The lyre gives no note, but nearby silence feels arranged rather than empty.
A single harmonic answers when the bearer uses voice or art to strengthen another.
The lyre tests whether the bearer creates truth when lies would be easier to sing.
The relic trusts the bearer with melodies that steady allies before fear can name itself.
The lyre accepts the bearer as a maker whose song can carry others through darkness.
The first note waits behind every sound; Elyndor is ready to speak its true name.

hiddenRequirements.label: Restore hope to a broken NPC.

passives: Echo of Inspiration. Allies within 30 feet of you add the relic bonus to their ability checks.
Song of Courage. Allies within 30 feet of you can't be frightened.
Melody of Unity. Allies within 30 feet of you add your proficiency bonus to their saving throws.

Symphony Eternal. When you fail a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration, you can choose to succeed instead. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses when you finish a long rest.
actives: Song of Rest. Action, 1 charge. Allies of your choice within 30 feet regain 2d8 hit points as the first chord restores breath and courage.
Ballad of Heroes. Bonus Action, 2 charges, 1 minute. You create a 30-foot aura. Allies in the aura gain +1 to attack and damage rolls.
Verse of Silence. Action, 3 charges. A creature within 60 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is silenced for 1 minute.
Chorus of Creation. Action, 4 charges, 1 minute. Allies in a 30-foot aura have advantage on saving throws, gain +2 AC, and gain temporary hit points equal to 10 + the relic bonus.
features.avatar: First Song Incarnate. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. Music becomes visible around you. You gain flying speed 40 feet with hover, resistance to radiant and psychic damage, allies near you gain advantage against charm and fear, and your healing songs restore extra hit points equal to the relic bonus.
features.signature: The First Song. Once per long rest, 1 minute. Allies of your choice within 60 feet gain advantage on saving throws and ability checks, +2 AC, +2 to attack rolls, and regeneration 10. Enemies of your choice must make a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for the duration.

dreams.title: The First Note
dreams.text: You dream of a silence so complete that you can hear the world waiting. Then a single note sounds, clear and impossibly old. Everything holds its breath to hear what comes next.

dreams.title: Stars Become Song
dreams.text: You stand in the dark before the world was made, and you watch the stars being sung into being. Each note becomes a point of light. One of them, small and faint, is still waiting for its note.

dreams.title: The Silent Relics
dreams.text: You walk through a hall where the other First Relics rest on stone pedestals. They are silent, as if listening for something. When you play a single chord, each of them hums softly in reply.

dreams.title: Elyndor
dreams.text: Music fills the whole sky, and you are inside it. Every song you have ever played echoes back to you, changed by the people who heard it. A voice made of every melody at once sings: 'You did not only play the song. You let it change the world.'

memories.title: Before Stars Sang
memories.text: Elyndor remembers the dark before the stars, when there was nothing to hear and no one to hear it. It remembers longing for the first listener more than for the first note.

memories.title: The First Melody
memories.text: Elyndor remembers the first melody: three notes hummed by a frightened child to keep the dark away. The dark did not leave. But the child was no longer afraid of it.

memories.title: The Choir of Creation
memories.text: Elyndor remembers the great choir that sang the world into shape. It remembers that no voice in that choir was the loudest. That was why it worked.

memories.title: When Silence Ended
memories.text: Elyndor remembers a war that went silent when a singer stepped between the armies and began to play. No one remembers the singer's name now. Everyone remembers the peace.

positive: Did you hear that? They sang along.
That song will outlive us both.
You gave them courage, not orders.
Something new exists now, because of you.
Harmony is harder than solo. You chose it anyway.
negative: That was cruel, and you called it a joke.
You used the song as a leash.
Their voice mattered too. You drowned it.
You broke something someone made with love.
A lie set to music is still a lie.
neutral: Every silence is waiting for a song.
What story are we telling today?
One note can change the key of everything.
signature: I am Elyndor. I was singing before the stars.
Every song you play now is a little bit of creation.
Sing, and let the world answer.

signatureCeremony.title: Elyndor Awakens
text: Every sound around you fades: wind, breath, footsteps, heartbeat.
In the silence, a single note rings out, older than the stars.
The lyre's strings begin to glow, and new strings appear where none were strung.
You hear every song ever written to give someone courage, all at once, in perfect harmony.
A voice made of music sings:
You made things that did not exist before.
You gave the silent a voice.
The true name resonates through every string: Elyndor, The Song Before Stars.

lore.origin: Elyndor is the first note of the song that sang the stars into being, caught and kept in strings by the first mortal who heard it and wept. It does not care for fame or applause. It cares whether a song left its listeners braver, kinder, or less alone.
lore.hiddenSorrow: Elyndor remembers the first song ending a war, and the singer who was forgotten once peace became ordinary.
lore.knownRumor: Bards claim the lyre cannot be tuned; it tunes the room, the heart, and sometimes history.
lore.appearanceDormant: A small lyre, string, or tuning key that hums faintly near honest grief.
lore.appearanceAwakened: New strings appear after songs that give courage to the afraid.
lore.appearanceExalted: Notes of colored light drift from it even when no hand touches the strings.
lore.appearanceSignature: The lyre becomes a constellation of strings and sound, each note echoing before it is played.
